description: South African tax number validation: checks a 10-digit SARS VAT registration number or income tax reference number (format and modulus-10 check digit) and says which type it is. Format check only, not a SARS registration lookup; nothing is stored. Useful for invoices, supplier onboarding and form validation. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

number.description: VAT or income tax number; spaces, dashes and slashes are ignored

name: za_validate_tax_number
title: South African VAT number and income tax number check (SARS format)
